newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Pacific Andes in 1-for-4 bonus issue.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Andes in 1-for-4 bonus issue.

text.p: Pacific Andes (Holdings) Ltd said on Monday it proposed to issue 38.3 million new ordinary shares of US$0.20 each in a one-for-four bonus issue.

The firm said in a statement the shares would rank pari passu in all apsects with existing ordinary shares except that they would not qualify for the first and final dividends to be paid to shareholders for the financial year ended March 31, 1997.

Pacific Andes said the bonus issue, to be approved by shareholders, the Stock Exchange of Singapore and possibly the Bermuda Monetary Authority, where the firm is incorporated, reflected good performance in the year to March 31.
Last week the frozen seafood to shipping services firm announced net profits up 43 percent to Hong Kong $75.63 million from HK$58.79 million previously and said it would pay a five percent dividend.
Pacific Andes said it expected to be able to maintain the absolute quantum of the dividend in the year to March 31, 1998.
